name: boom
description: Start each agent session in a registered repository with its rules in full and its other claims by name. Before the first edit of a file in a context, give the rules of that context. Stop a write that holds an old word of an accepted term. Teach an agent to use Boom with three skills: using-boom to read and cite claims, proposing-claims to propose each kind, and writing-narratives to explain a design with its claims.
